title: The Power of Habit
author: Charles Duhigg
summary: Charles Duhigg explains the habit loop of cue, routine and reward, and how people, companies and communities change habits. He draws on stories from Alcoa, Starbucks and the civil rights movement.
readIf: you want a readable account of how habits form and how to alter them.
skipIf: you want deep science or a detailed plan, as the book is mostly anecdote.
